verdict.rationale: Crossmint's Agent Checkouts, Agent Cards, and Agent Wallets APIs let any AI agent complete a purchase from a merchant with user-authorized spend limits (crossmint-docs-4, crossmint-supp-1, crossmint-supp-7), which is the core payment-rail capability needed for in-chat checkout. However, the evidence never documents a specific integration, plugin, or partnership placing this inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot surfaces — it's generic agent/API infrastructure that a developer would have to wire into those surfaces themselves. Missing for 10: named integrations or case studies showing live checkout inside ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Copilot, and confirmation the flow works within those assistants' UI constraints (e.g., no staging environment, poll-only status per crossmint-supp-7 suggests real-time chat UX is unproven).
